It is not a Diesel 30 trailer concrete pump, not a 380 V hydraulic sprayer, not M9 plaster and not a mixing plant. Quote only; no list price.
answerBlock.who: Contractors spraying mortar or concrete where 380 V is not available and 5 m³/h / ≤6 mm / 80 m / 40 m covers the spray.
factors: Diesel fuel available and no 380 V grid
Particle ≤6 mm, not trailer-pump centimetre stone

faqs.question: Is this the Diesel 30 concrete pump?
faqs.answer: No. Diesel 30 is a trailer concrete pump: 4105 diesel 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 60 m / 180 m. This page is a spraying machine at 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h, particle ≤6 mm.

faqs.question: When should I use a 380 V hydraulic sprayer instead?
faqs.answer: If 380 V is available, compare the hydraulic concrete sprayers (7.5/9 kW at 5 m³/h or 11/15 kW at 7 m³/h). Plaster at ≤4 mm → M9.
